notes.title: YoloMouse 1.12.0
notes.content:
This one adds several workshop features including sorting, filtering, search, and ratings. Added default cursor options like resizing all unbound game cursors. Then the larger update, that will go unnoticed, was support for scripted cursors. So far only the existing Pyro, Prism, Petals were ported over so not much to see. But next update the full capabilities here are planned :)

Also snuck in an XBRZ upscaler for existing game cursors :D

Otherwise some QoL changes and various fixes. A few I couldn't get to in time however...

 Theres some issues while using Lossless Scaling thats more complicated than expected.
 Investigated HDR cursor brightness problem. Unfortunatelly this isnt an easy fix since its a Windows bug with no known workarounds. The only way around this in YoloMouse is to show the cursor via an overlay which can be done by enabling "settings > compliance > passive" but that has its own downsides.

notes.title: YoloMouse 1.10.1
notes.content:
The Effects feature adds a visual enhancement to your existing cursor. The initial effects are Scope and Halo. These currently lack settings like size and color which will be added next update.

Effects are also the first to use LUA scripting, the future of how YM's complex/overlay cursors will be made. This may take a few more updates to mature, but once ready Editor and Workshop support will be added.

Additionally anticheat compliance options have been added, primarily to satisfy reports involving "The Finals" and Roblox. The "Stealth" option is meant to avoid a false blacklist by "The Finals". The "Passive" option makes YM fully non-intrusive and only behave as an overlay (except in Windows mode). This allows it to work with Roblox. Both options may apply to other current/future games.

And finally fixed the stuck hotkeys issue due to a Windows bug that Microsoft likely will never fix lol. Fortunately the alternative works perfectly :)

Updated TODO list...

NEW: Setting: Compliance Ptealth: Renames the yolomouse executables to avoid the janky "The Finals" anticheat.

notes.content:
Another small update to address issues...

These came up as I was working on cursor effects which I thought was a great time to update the rendering engine in order to support scripted effects and cursors. So I got that part done and as a side effect it improved perfmance, yay! :)

Otherwise these fixes are fairly urgent so I had to push them out before features, especially the stuck input triggering unwanted hotkeys. The startup UX was also tweaked since too many people were accidentally changing their windows cursors when they didn't mean to.

The HDR gamma issue appears to be an unsolved Windows bug so its a little more complex but I have a plan on how to get around it. For now you may find that sizing up your cursor will work better than when its smaller.

The mirror option (flip cursor) has been requested for a while and finally here. This should work with all cursors except the 3D ones which will supported in a future update.

Expert mode is to disable some noob features that some found annoying, like tooltips and the YM UI starting on launch.

Safemode forces YM to go full CPU mode (no GPU). This is mainly to fix issues on some systems. Note that any cursors that would have used the GPU will be quite laggy.

Otherwise several important fixes, especially with hotkeys and the create tab.

Some TODO items were pushed to next update due to the urgency of hotfixes in this update.

notes.title: YoloMouse 1.8.3
notes.content:
Finally an update! xD

Had hoped I left YM in perfect shape while I went off to work on another project, but alas software can never be perfect. These are items that crept up over time...

One in particular is based on reported issues I couldn't reproduce. But I knew these must be related to the hooking system (where YM jumps into a game and tweaks its cursor). So I ended up rewriting the whole thing to fix a lot of performance and stability issues. One caveat is you may be nagged with an admin popup for old 32bit games that run as admin - like DAOC.

The other important update finally fixes the wierd input issues some may have noticed in certain anticheat protected games like Lost Ark.

Also some new cursors! :)

Btw, that project I mentioned is a new crosshair app called YoloX. It uses much of YM's tech and some improvements of its own that I rolled back into YM.

notes.title: YoloMouse 1.7.0
notes.content:
Biggest update ever that no one will notice (yet) :D

A new overlay has arrived that wields the power of a full game engine!: https://godotengine.org/ . Now anything will be possible as far as possibilities go for a cursor ;) An editor and workshop publishing support has also been added.

But all that time was spent integrating this and no time to make anything to show it off :( But thats ok, this is the last major feature for YM on the list. Remaining updates will focus on content, fixes, performance, and remaining minor features.

So just the basic 3D cursors (prism, petals) have been ported over for now. Pyro has been removed and replaced with a similar PixelFire cursor. If anyone misses Pyro let me know and it'll find its way back in some form :)

For those concerned about bloat. This update actually debloats YM by separating out the overlay which will only be loaded upon use. You should otherwise see better performance and memory use.

Also several small updates and fixes...

The old overlay still exists but is now simplified for anticheat purposes only and will only be used if the new one isnt needed.
For those seeing wierd input issues in anticheat games like Lost Ark and Albion, this has a fix but requires those games to be run as admin. Looking into avoiding this restriction next update.

notes.title: YoloMouse 1.6.0
notes.content:
Another big one :D

After much research into bypassing anticheat protected games a very clean and safe (not bannable) method has been discovered. This allows YM to function with anticheat protected games like Lost Ark almost identically to unprotected games. Additional related improvements have been added like overlay cursor support in dedicated fullscreen.

Also a long overdue tutorial :D This is the first step to making YM fully self documented.

VSYNC is now enabled for the overlay cursors. I'm not sure why I had this off, but it should buff performance a little.

Finally an announcement of a major upcoming feature: Godot game engine integration. This will unleash YM's true potential with fully moddable 3D cursors :)

A new feature has been added to the cursor picker menu (CTRL ALT C) that shows all discovered game/app cursors instead of just the cursor you were hovering over. notes.title: YoloMouse 1.2.1
notes.content:
A bigger update this time

This one adds universal windows cursor support. This means YM can replace the regular windows cursors in a general and more compatible manner. To use: hit CTRL ALT C (or new hotkeys) as usual. If the current cursor is a windows cursor, it will be replaced instead of the usual targeted app cursor. Next update will expose a choice to target the app instead.

Removed hotkeys are back by popular request. All hotkeys are as follows, with a few small changes:

 CTRL ALT C: Opens cursor selection UI
 CTRL ALT 1: Changes current cursor. Repeat to cycle choices.
 CTRL ALT 2: Change colors for currently bound cursor. Repeat to cycle choices.
 CTRL ALT +: Increase current cursor size
 CTRL ALT -: Decrease current cursor size
 CTRL ALT D: Change all unbound cursors to the currently bound cursor
 CTRL ALT 0: Restore original cursor
 CTRL ALT P: Restore all cursors

Note that these hotkeys can be changed or removed (none option) in the settings menu (taskbar > pink arrow > hotkeys).

Otherwise a few fixes were added, including lost saves.

UPDATES

notes.title: YoloMouse release!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone

After 6 years YoloMouse is out of beta. It's awesome how much YM has helped folks: From those finding game cursor visibility a nuisance to those with disabilities who simply couldn't play that game before. This is motivation enough to keep updating YM :)

This release introduces the following features:
 Code signed to allow trust and whitelisting by AntiCheat and AntiVirus vendors
 New 3D/overlay cursors including a flaming arrow using fluid dynamics simulation and a particle arrow affected by atmospheric physics.
 Multiple monitor support
 A GUI so you don't have to fiddle with .ini files
 Bunch of fixes and optimizations
Please send suggestions, concerns, bugs to support@dragonrisegames.com

Happy gaming! ːsteamhappyː
